# Planning work

Use this guide when a chosen direction needs to become an executable slice of repository work.

Read the relevant specification and repository instructions. Break the work at reviewable behavior boundaries, order dependent changes, and identify evidence that will show each result works. Name files and commands only when repository facts support them. Keep unresolved human decisions explicit rather than disguising them as implementation tasks. Preserve live plans and specifications until their owning retirement point.

The stage is complete when the plan has a clear goal, bounded tasks, dependencies, validation evidence, and honest handoff conditions. A worker should be able to begin without rediscovering the design.
